dedupe_keys.name: falkland islands government 2021 census tables workbook including households by electrical power source power stations settlement generators wind solar heating and cooking fuel housing unit type and energy costs by location

description: The Falkland Islands Government publishes the 2021 Census as a report and a 61-sheet table workbook on its census findings page. The housing and energy tables break down usually occupied housing units by type of unit and by location, split into Stanley, East and West Falkland camp and the surrounding islands. Table 34 counts the 1,352 households by electrical power source: 1,174 are supplied by Stanley Power Station, 7 by Fox Bay Power Station, 34 by settlement generators and the rest by private generators, wind turbines, solar panels or hybrid systems, with 48 relying on a wind turbine. Table 32 gives the main heating fuel, led by kerosene and diesel, with trends back to 1991, and other tables cover cooking fuel, monthly energy costs, rooms, tenure, accommodation standard, vehicles and appliances. Coverage is national, for the whole territory. Format and access: free XLSX and PDF downloads, no registration. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: counts are small, the military base (MPC) is excluded from housing tables, and tables are published as formatted sheets. Simulation uses: off-grid and microgrid supply mixes for remote settlements, and heating demand by fuel. Related records: none for the Falkland Islands in the catalogue.
